usage contains completion_tokens, prompt_tokens, total_tokens, and prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens.

Input details include prompt_tokens_details.text_tokens, prompt_tokens_details.image_tokens, prompt_tokens_details.video_tokens, and prompt_tokens_details.audio_tokens. Output details include completion_tokens_details.text_tokens, completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens, and completion_tokens_details.audio_tokens.

Explicit cache details include prompt_tokens_details.cache_creation.cache_creation_input_tokens and prompt_tokens_details.cache_creation.ephemeral_5m_input_tokens.

Set stream_options.include_usage to receive usage on the final streaming chunk.

Set enable_thinking to select thinking mode where the model supports it.
